scope_note: Independent visual review of receipts only. No integration, manifest, research or power changes. For each of the 2 requested slugs I viewed the native 1254px PNG, a 200px downscale, and targeted native crops (nootaikok: face, both hands, legs/boots, seals, hunters; ogetsuhime: face and rice origin at the eyes, zoomed left and right silkworm/cocoon crops at the crown, hand, robe/body). I compared them against the receipt visual_requirements and the research claims embedded in the ledger. Before writing, each PNG's SHA-256 was recomputed and matched against the receipt native_sha256, the Codex visual_review hash, the ledger item hash and the Codex root native review in drafts/root/codex-native-reviews.json. Claude wrote only root_visual_review (plus correction_notes on the reject) and the receipt status, and synced the ledger item status. The ledger was re-read immediately before writing, and only the item status changed. No PNG, Codex visual_review, Codex native review or other receipt was modified. Reject: nootaikok (the r01 faults are fixed, but the spirit now reads as an ordinary present-day Inuit man in a parka with a photographic, casually smirking face, in a high-key, sunny cyan scene; it fails Uji Sangar #2/#7 as idlirvirissong did in 2079-r02). Pass: ogetsuhime (a painterly, reverent crop-origin miracle with rice from both closed eyes and silkworms spinning cocoons at the crown).

results.reason: Viewed native 1254px, 200px, and face, both-hand, legs/boots, seal and hunter crops. What works and answers r01: the void hood and friar robe are gone. One humanlike spirit with one head, a clearly visible face, two brown eyes and a closed mouth, in a heavy, matte, fully opaque black fur-and-skin parka with a black fur ruff, black trousers and black boots (dressed in black, nootaikok-c03). Two open offering hands, each a thumb plus four fingers, and two legs. It is fully underwater in a still blue ice channel inside an iceberg (c01/c03), with no ice magic, aura or text. Three anatomically normal seals swim past toward the opening (offers seals, leads hunters to seals, c03/c04). The hunters now wear fur-ruffed parkas, one holds a harpoon, and a skin-covered boat lies beside them. It still fails Uji Sangar #2 and #7, for the same reason idlirvirissong was rejected in 2079-r02. (1) The spirit now reads as an ordinary present-day Inuit man in a parka. The face is a photographic stock-portrait face with a casual, slightly smug half-smile and a raised brow, not a dignified spirit. There is no house painterly treatment, and nothing about the figure sets it apart from a man swimming with seals. At 200px the image reads as 'smiling man in a parka with seals under the ice', a pleasant wildlife or tourism photo, not an awe-inspiring guardian who rules the icebergs and glaciers (c01/c02). (2) The lighting is high-key and evenly bright: a sunny cyan scene with blue sky and puffs of cloud through the opening. That is cheerful, not the low-key, single-source majesty that §6.2 #5/#9 ask for, and §6.5 says benevolent beings must still be awe-inspiring. (3) Minor: the two hunters seem to stand knee-deep and waist-deep in open waves rather than on the floe edge, and the split above/below-water perspective is incoherent.
results.correction_notes: Keep: one spirit dressed in black (nootaikok-c03) with a clearly visible humanlike face and two eyes, heavy matte black skin/fur Arctic clothing, two open five-fingered hands in an offering gesture, in the water inside an iceberg/glacier (c01/c03), and seals streaming past toward the hunters (c03/c04). Keep the ice walls still, with no ice magic, aura, glow or text. Fix: (a) It must read as a spirit, not a man swimming. Paint it in the house painterly style, not as a photographic portrait. Give it an ageless, solemn, dignified face with a calm, steady, direct gaze and a closed mouth: kindly but grave, never a casual grin or smirk. Show it at ease in deep water where no person could be: no breath bubbles, the fur ruff drifting weightlessly, the body hanging upright and unmoving in the current as the master of this place. (b) Build majesty from framing and light, not invented anatomy. Use a tight, foreshortened, low camera so the figure looms close and fills the frame. Make the deep blue-black interior of the iceberg it rules (c01/c02) a low-key darkness. Let ONE shaft of daylight fall from a small, distant opening high above onto its face and hands. Have the seals rise out of the dark depths behind and around it and stream past its open hands toward the light, as if it is releasing them (offers seals, c03). No bright, sunny cyan scene, blue sky or cloud puffs. (c) Keep the Inuit hunters tiny and secondary: small figures on the edge of the ice floe at the far opening, in fur-ruffed parkas, with a harpoon and a kayak, standing on ice, not in open water.

results.reason: Viewed native 1254px, 200px, and face/eye-origin, crown/silkworm (left and right, zoomed), hand and robe/body crops. This redraw answers the r01 reject. One adult goddess (ogetsuhime-c01) lies dead (c04), with one head, two closed eyes and a serene closed mouth, and no wounds, blood or decay. She is painted in visible impasto brushwork as an ancient goddess, not as a photographic modern woman. Her layered ivory-over-russet robes are fully opaque, with a crossed collar and long sleeves (editorial), and no body is exposed. One hand is visible at lower right, resting on the soil with natural relaxed fingers and no extra digits; the other arm recedes under the robe, and there are no extra limbs. Rice is born from her eyes (目から稲, c05): two dense sheaves spring directly from the closed eyes with no wound. They rise high overhead and bow under heavy golden ears that shed a shower of grain onto her robe and the dark earth (ordinary gravity; the ground stays still, with no soil magic). Silkworms are born from her head (頭から蚕, c05): four or five unmistakable pale, segmented silkworm caterpillars with dark eye-spots and prolegs sit at the crown, one rearing up and spinning fine silk onto two pearly cocoons. None are scattered on the soil, and they read as silkworms, not maggots. The receipt says three; the extra one or two are harmless editorial staging, since c05 gives no number. An extreme low, ground-level camera beside her head and one diagonal shaft of cold moonlight against walnut darkness make the rice tower over the viewer. At 200px it reads as a sacred crop-origin miracle with grain raining down: reverent and awe-inspiring, fitting a living Shinto tradition, not a sleeping woman, horror or a still life. No Susanoo, aura, text, border or borrowed design. The other c05 origins are left out by choice, which keeps the scene modest.
